question: What capacity retention did the aqueous-processed and the NMP-processed NMC 811 pouch cells show?
rendered: The aqueous-processed NMC 811 pouch cells showed a capacity retention of ~70%, while the NMP-processed cells showed a capacity retention of ~76%.
